chunks.subject: AP Research
chunks.title: Academic Paper exemplar — Sample G, 2/5
chunks.content: Sample G scored 2/5 (Report on Existing Knowledge with Simplistic Use of a Research Method). Topic: how (if at all) video games affect people — a broad initial topic. The paper names/uses a research method only simplistically and largely reports existing knowledge; the narrowing scope is not carried through into a genuine new-understanding argument. Illustrates the 2 band: method present but simplistic, still a report.
